# InkOS producer fixture

`inkos-source-first-pitch-review-v3.json` is a byte-for-byte copy of the packet generated by InkOS `buildFireflyPitchReviewPacketV3`, via `packages/core/src/__tests__/fixtures/source-first-pitch-review-fixture.ts`.

The producer artifact is `packages/core/src/__tests__/fixtures/source-first-pitch-review-v3.json`. The Storyyard test compares its bytes and reads that producer artifact directly when the sibling InkOS checkout is present. Set `INKOS_SOURCE_FIRST_REVIEW_FIXTURE` to test another producer checkout; an explicitly requested missing fixture fails.

This copy keeps receiver tests runnable from an independent Storyyard checkout. Regenerate it through the InkOS helper and copy the resulting JSON; do not separately hand-edit an equivalent receiver fixture.

The content is synthetic contract test data. It is not a real source analysis, model canary, human decision, or publication input. Nothing under this fixture directory is imported into the review queue.
